channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Anthropic’s Debut Shows the Disconnect Between Wall Street and Silicon Valley
item.description: The A.I. giant broke records with its initial public offering this week before a rocky first full day of trading, as the markets plunged on worries about artificial intelligence spending.

item.title: NPR: Killer robots: U.N. talks fall short of hopes for legally binding rules
item.description: U.N. talks in Geneva have failed to deliver binding rules on autonomous weapons, as humanitarian groups warn that military AI is advancing far faster than diplomacy.

item.title: BBC News: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting
item.description: Ukraine's president says Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine.

item.title: Al Jazeera: India’s opposition stages protests against Meta over account removals
item.description: Indian Youth Congress issues a seven-day 'ultimatum' to the US technology giant, urging it to lift all restrictions.

item.title: Ars Technica: “Race realism” isn’t realistic—and it isn’t good science
item.description: Modern genetics does not support claims of innate racial differences in intelligence.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: The Manosphere Isn’t Ready for Brothercore
item.description: Vulnerable, huggable, affirming, chiseled: Welcome to Hey Brother House, a content incubator for bros who just want to trauma-dump and play Mario Kart.

item.title: WIRED Science: A Space Probe Returns to Asteroids Where NASA Tested Planetary Defense Systems
item.description: Several years ago, NASA tested systems for deterring dangerous space rocks. Now, a probe from the European Space Agency is returning to the scene to investigate.

item.title: WIRED Business: Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation
item.description: Amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report and an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, sources tell WIRED the Nvidia board’s main issue was the former CEO’s “lack of candor.”

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: ‘He Asked Me If I’m a Honeypot’
item.description: Jokes and memes abound from the Jensen Huang affair scandal, but the reputational damage to Asian American women has already been done.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Novelist Colson Whitehead’s Trophy-Filled Trophy Co-op
item.description: He bought the prewar corner unit when he won his second Pulitzer.
